description: Add, remove, enable, or disable an IPSec policy. Idempotent by composite key (srcAddress + dstAddress + tunnel).

confirmationToken.description: Token from a prior APPROVAL_REQUIRED response. Re-submit the identical call with this token to confirm the destructive action.

dstAddress.description: Destination CIDR — part of composite idempotency key

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

saDstAddress.description: SA destination IP for tunnel mode

saSourceAddress.description: SA source IP for tunnel mode

srcAddress.description: Source CIDR — part of composite idempotency key

tunnel.description: Tunnel mode — part of composite idempotency key

name: manage_ipsec_policy
title: Manage IPSec Policy
